name: Enflame CloudBlaze S60 spec sheet (sourced to Enflame S60 product manual, hardware doc center)
notes: 48 GB GDDR6 at 672 GB/s, attributed to Enflame's official S60 product manual; Enflame's own pages (enflame-tech.com, support.enflame-tech.com) are behind a Tencent WAF that returned 403/antibot to every retrieval attempt, so the vendor page could not be read directly.
